item.title: U.S. trade deficit narrows sharply as exports hit record high
item.description: The U.S. trade deficit narrowed sharply in January as exports surged to a record $302 billion and imports fell, potentially boosting first-quarter economic growth.

item.title: Fed still expected to cut rates in June despite inflation risk
item.description: Economists expect the Federal Reserve to cut interest rates in June despite rising oil prices from the Iran conflict and inflation still above the Fed’s 2% target.

item.title: Line 5 pipeline fight reviewed by Michigan Supreme Court
item.description: The Michigan Supreme Court hears arguments over Enbridge's Line 5 relocation under the Straits of Mackinac, with environmental groups seeking broader review.

item.title: U.S. unfair-trade probes could lead to new tariffs
item.description: The Trump administration launched trade probes into excess industrial capacity and forced labor that could lead to new tariffs on China, the EU and other partners.

item.title: Iran war could drive everyday costs higher in U.S.
item.description: The Iran war is pushing oil above $100, raising U.S. gas prices, shipping costs and inflation concerns while disrupting global supply chains and flights.

item.title: On the Market: Shakopee industrial, Minneapolis apartments, Corcoran land
item.description: Shakopee industrial buildings, a Minneapolis apartment property and Corcoran rural land highlight new Twin Cities commercial and development opportunities.

item.title: Housing First drops lawsuit over Edina tree ordinance
item.description: Housing First Minnesota dropped its lawsuit against Edina after the city repealed and replaced a disputed tree ordinance tied to development and tree replacement fees.

item.title: U.S. single-family homebuilding drops amid harsh winter
item.description: U.S. single-family housing starts fell 2.8% in January due to winter weather, tariffs, and worker shortages, with future permits also declining.

item.title: Aeon withdraws from Minneapolis Kmart site RFP
item.description: Aeon withdrew from the New Nicollet redevelopment RFP for the former Kmart site in Minneapolis, leaving Trellis Co. as the sole developer candidate.

item.title: Rogers approves TIF for 181-unit apartment redevelopment
item.description: Rogers approved $7.62M in TIF for a 181-unit market-rate apartment project on the former Willis Trucking site, clearing the way for construction to begin this summer.
